The '''gnarled rancor''' was a [[Species/Legends|species]] of [[Rancor/Legends|rancor]] that could be found on [[Dathomir/Legends|Dathomir]]. In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]], [[Shibb Nisshil]] hired a [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] to get a [[DNA/Legends|DNA]] sample from one, so that he could create an army of [[cyber-rancor]]s.
